verdict.rationale: OpenRouter's product is a documented public API: a single unified endpoint for hundreds of models, a normalized schema, API reference docs for streaming, and programmatic model listing and key management. A probe confirmed a published OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json, and community users independently describe driving models in production through the same API key and request format.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: OpenRouter gives you access to hundreds of AI models through a single API endpoint.
OpenRouter normalizes the schema across models and providers so you only need to learn one.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://openrouter.ai/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
list every available slug programmatically via the GET /api/v1/models endpoint
OpenRouter provides endpoints to programmatically manage your API keys
the ability to run any AI model with the same api key and same request has been great to experiment with new models and being able to switch models in prod with minimal effort
